blocks.h2: Gas Fireplace Trouble in Elgin Homes
blocks.intro: What we hear most in the fall:

tiles.body: The igniter works but the pilot isn't getting gas. Often debris after a summer off.
Soot from a dirty burner, shifted logs or a venting issue.
Leave first. Call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside.

blocks.h2: Gas Fireplace Repair, Cleaning and Yearly Service
blocks.intro: We cover the gas side, start to finish:

steps.body: Pilots, igniters, thermocouples, thermopiles, valves, remotes and switches.
Burner, pilot and glass cleaned, logs reset, connections leak-tested, vent checked.
New fireplace or insert? See [gas line installation](/elgin/gas-line-installation).

blocks.intro: Elgin's fireplaces are as varied as its houses.

items.body: Many older homes near downtown have original masonry fireplaces that were fitted with gas logs later. The flue must be open and clear, and the gas connection tight.
An insert vents through a liner inside the chimney. A damaged liner can let exhaust back into the room.

items.h3: Builder Units on the West Side
items.body: Direct-vent fireplaces from the 1990s and 2000s are now 17 to 36 years old. Most parts are still available.
Keep a working CO detector near every gas appliance and on every level.

blocks.h2: Gas Fireplace Questions From Elgin Homeowners

items.q: When should I service my gas fireplace?
items.preview: Once a year, in early fall.
items.answer: Once a year, ideally in September or October, before you need it.

items.q: Can an old masonry fireplace burn gas logs safely?
items.preview: Yes, if the chimney is sound and the gas is installed right.
items.answer: Yes, if the chimney is in good shape and drawing well and the gas line and valve are installed correctly. We handle the gas side and flag anything that needs a chimney specialist.

items.q: Why is my fireplace glass turning black?
items.preview: Incomplete burning from dirt, log placement or venting.
items.answer: Black glass means the gas isn't burning cleanly. A dirty burner, logs moved out of place or a venting issue are the usual causes. A service visit fixes most of them.

items.q: What if I smell gas near the fireplace?
items.preview: Leave and call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside.
items.answer: Leave the house without touching switches. Call Nicor Gas or 911 from outside, then call us once it's safe.

items.q: How much does gas fireplace repair cost in Elgin?
items.preview: It depends on what failed. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the part that failed and the fireplace model. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
